acc1.set: (q, k, v) => { const a = String(v).trim().split(/\s+/).map(Number).filter(x => isFinite(x) && x > 0); if (a.length >= 3) { q.cols = 4; q.gauge = a[1]; q.gauge2 = a[0]; } else if (a.length) { q.cols = 2; q.gauge = a[0]; } }

acc2.set: (q, k, v) => { const s = String(v).trim(); if (s.includes(' ')) q.pitches = s; else { q.pitches = ''; q.pitch = +s || q.pitch; } }
